Early Settlement Estimator

If you're thinking of clearing your loan early, UK lenders must give you a rebate on the interest. They're also allowed to add about 2 months of interest as a final charge. Put your loan in below to see roughly what your settlement figure would be.
blocks.2:
How this is calculated

The natural guess is that settling early means paying off today's balance. The figure is usually a little more than that. Under the Consumer Credit (Early Settlement) Regulations 2004, lenders calculate interest up to the date you settle. They can then add a notice period, usually 28 days, and another 30 days on top. Those two windows are why it's known as the "58-day rule", and it's standard across most UK personal and car loans.
